production_rule: Developer harness must remain Enabled=false in any production/publish configuration.

tests.name: Registries initialize once
steps: Observe bootstrap events for status, ability, class, shop, recipe, taming, and hireable registries.
pass: Actor registry creates one runtime key per player.

tests.name: Profile leave/rejoin
steps: Purchase or craft one durable unlock.
Leave session and rejoin with persistence enabled.

tests.name: Repeated shop interaction is idempotent
pass: No second durable unlock is written.

tests.name: Recipe prerequisite and atomic spend
steps: Attempt SLR-003 before WPN-001 is unlocked.
pass: Second attempt spends exact coalesced costs.

tests.name: Item Granter weapon delivery
steps: Bind WPN-001 delivery adapter to configured Item Granter.
pass: GrantItem dispatch occurs for purchasing agent.
Persistent ownership remains valid if the physical item is later removed.

tests.name: Missing delivery binding timeout
steps: Temporarily omit one non-production delivery adapter.
pass: No materials are recharged or refunded automatically.
Timeout event is emitted for diagnostics.

tests.name: Self ability two-phase commit
pass: Ability enters pending before adapter result.
Cooldown starts only after successful adapter result.

tests.name: Targeted actor ability
pass: Target key resolves through actor registry.

tests.name: Position ability snapshot
pass: Position context is created from view snapshot.
Class resource is reserved before adapter result.

tests.name: Adapter timeout rollback
steps: Use a test ability with no responding adapter.
pass: Pending request times out near configured timeout.

tests.name: ReserveWhileActive Crown Bond
steps: Start successful Royal Scent taming flow.
pass: Reservation transfers from ability request to companion bond.
Bond remains held while tameable is active.

tests.name: Taming timeout
steps: Do not complete the required sequence.

tests.name: Hire limits and allowed orders
steps: Attempt to exceed per-NPC or class companion limit.

tests.name: BOS-011 cleanup and reward
steps: Run all four King Without Pulse phases.
pass: Dead Treasury and purchased minions are cleared.
No phase hazards persist after completion.

tests.name: Grave Market Eclipse success/failure cleanup
steps: Run EVT-011 once to success and once to failure on separate sessions/profiles.
pass: Regional outcome persists only where authored.

tests.name: Player unregister full cleanup
steps: Create statuses, ability state, class reservation, target, position context, spawn reservation, delivery request, and companion bond.
pass: Actor unregister clears every session-owned state.
No pending adapter or delivery request remains for old runtime key.

tests.name: NPC despawn cleanup
steps: Bind an NPC as companion and apply status.

tests.name: Ossuary March border traversal
steps: Traverse each REG-001 neighbor border repeatedly with and without combat.
pass: World Partition loads/unloads without missing collision or navigation.
No temporary event actors survive outside intended region.

tests.name: Dense slice profiling
steps: Run Grave Market Eclipse with maximum candidate AI cap and active companions.
Record Spatial Profiler and Memory Snapshot.
pass: Temporary VFX/actors return toward baseline after cleanup.
Observed bottlenecks are recorded before production status.

tests.name: Redundant lethal telegraphs
steps: Exercise each lethal boss/event mechanic with audio reduced and again with visual noise reduced.
pass: Critical mechanics retain at least two readable channels where practical.
Color is not the sole identifier for critical state.
No HUD/status bridge removes accessibility-critical warnings.
